New SCCTG awards focus on Workforce Pell efforts

The U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) is awarding $65 million in grants to consortia in seven states to help community colleges develop high-quality, short-term programs that can qualify for Workforce Pell funding. In its announcement...

This is now an implementation story rather than a policy announcement. The useful questions are which programs qualify, how quickly colleges can build compliant offerings, and whether students receive enough guidance to judge short-term credentials well.

For community colleges, the question is whether the implementation capacity matches the ambition.
